name: AudioSet
description: A large-scale dataset of human-labeled 10-second YouTube audio segments annotated with labels from a 632-class ontology of sound events.
citation: Gemmeke, J. F., Ellis, D. P. W., Freedman, D., et al. (2017). Audio Set: An ontology and human-labeled dataset for audio events. 2017 IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech and Signal Processing (ICASSP), 776–780. https://doi.org/10.1109/ICASSP.2017.7952261

license.identifier: License not specified (not a standard SPDX identifier)
license.notes: AudioSet provides annotations and links to YouTube videos; the underlying audio remains subject to YouTube's terms and the rights of the respective content owners. The upstream dataset page does not specify a standard SPDX license for the dataset. Review upstream terms and rights before use or redistribution.
